evidence_items.explanation: Launch-day reporting says OpenAI's presenter described using model-generated (synthetic) data to train GPT-5. This supports the suspected synthetic-data element, but it is a secondary report and gives no scale.

unresolved_gaps: No primary OpenAI text read here gives the amount of synthetic data used, so 'massive amounts' cannot be confirmed.
